Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 123 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | Many menu items can be made vegetarian; they offer tofu pad thai, vegetable spring rolls, and a vegetarian curry option. |
| **Siam Square** | 456 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60614 | Known for their “Vegetarian Pad Thai” and “Vegetarian Green Curry.” |
| **Siam Square** | 789 W. Lake St., Chicago, IL 60657 | Offers a “Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup” and a “Vegetarian Massaman Curry.” |

*(Note: All three locations are part of the same Siam Square chain, which consistently provides vegetarian options across its outlets.)*
